title.narrative: Enhancing Youth Employability and Local Economic Development in Upper Egypt

description.narrative: The project endeavors to provide solutions to tackle youth unemployment in one Upper Egyptian governorates (to be selected among Sohag, Qena, Aswan, or Luxor). The intervention will enhance both the employability and entrepreneurship of local youth while boosting the capacity of local MSMEs to provide new employment opportunities for young women and men. The intervention will focus on jobs profiles that are required by the local economy, yet are currently disregarded by the educational system. Analysis of the local economic texture highlighted that opportunities for job creation are available in the agro-food sector (particularly horticulture and food processing) as well as in the solid waste management sector (and connected sub-sectors, such as recycling and waste to energy solutions). The project will also facilitate match-making activities between jobseekers and perspective employers in collaboration with local schools and universities. Target youth will acquire entrepreneurial attitudes enabling them to establish/enhance their own business.
